subject.title: fix(secrets): trust developer-id signed binary in macOS keychain ACLs

question: Should gogcli automatically enable macOS Keychain application trust for binaries with a stable signing TeamIdentifier, or require narrower release-identity gating or signed-upgrade proof before merge?
rationale: This changes credential ACL behavior for OAuth tokens, and CI cannot prove the real macOS Keychain upgrade boundary that motivated the prior false default.

options.title: Require Signed-Upgrade Proof
options.body: Merge after a Developer-ID/Homebrew-signed build shows token creation, reinstall or upgrade, and token read behavior matching the intended prompt policy.

options.title: Narrow The Signing Gate
options.body: Restrict auto trust to the official release identity if maintainers do not want any non-ad-hoc TeamIdentifier to receive application trust.

options.title: Keep Default False
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged and ship only an explicit override if the automatic ACL policy is not settled.

recommendation.title: Require Signed-Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a Developer-ID/Homebrew-signed build shows token creation, reinstall or upgrade, and token read behavior matching the intended prompt policy.
